notes: Read by tools/install/platform_check.py and tools/install/spinnaker_download.py before the installer changes anything.
Each entry is something reachAQ has been installed and run on. Add a platform here only after the installer has run on it end to end.

nvidia.why: torch 2.7 on CUDA 12.8 (the torch extra of reachaq): CUDA 12.8 needs driver 570.26 or newer, and the build carries kernels for compute capability 7.5 to 12.0.

spinnaker.why: Spinnaker 3.2 is the SDK the reference rig runs (3.2.0.57) and the 3.2 Python binding imports against it. Major.minor must match between the SDK and the binding; the binding is the build for the environment's Python (3.10, cp310).
